editorial_and_critical_boundary.established_source: Andreas Urs Sommer, Historischer und kritischer Kommentar zu Nietzsches Werken, Band 6/2, 2013
findings: The 1908 first edition substantially follows the Köselitz editorial copy.
Passages were removed or destroyed in the family editorial history.
The later Colli/Montinari reconstruction is philologically more reliable than the earlier editions.
The 1908 edition was edited by Raoul Richter and designed by Henry van de Velde.
editorial_and_critical_boundary.decision: admit the 1908 physical witness and its edition-scoped expression without treating it as an author-final or critical text
